cases.rationale: Two actual men are visible directly and in the mirror; the white counter has identifiable washbasins/taps and several toiletry bottles, including a handled cleaning bottle below. The round pedestal object is a mirror, not a wine glass or clock. Small upright toiletry implements and the item near the man's hands lack enough head detail to distinguish a toothbrush from grooming tools, so toothbrush is unclear. No other defined category has visible supporting evidence after considering all 75 definitions.

A seated person's torso and hands appear behind a wooden work surface. They hold a bottle with a neck, and a drinking cup is beside it. Several recognizable mobile phone handsets lie in the foreground. The longer black button-covered unit on the papers could be a phone handset or remote control; remote remains unclear. Papers and a Motorola box are not books or computer displays, and the electronic work setup does not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no other category ambiguity remains.

The crop contains a lidded paper coffee cup and two actual frosted doughnuts, including a green ring doughnut and a chocolate-topped filled doughnut. They are not plain bagels or cake. Wrappers and tray surfaces provide no identifiable dining-table structure. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A small brown stuffed bear sits against a patterned bag, distinct from an actual bear; the large pale plush at right does not establish another actual animal. Green drinking cups, a fork with visible tines, a dining knife, and the upright green spoon with a bowl and handle are visible. The upright publication at right has a bound book cover and spine. The white dish is a flat plate, and the wicker storage chest with a decorative setting is not an identifiable dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The kitchen contains wooden individual stools, a sink with faucet, a partly cropped wall microwave at left, and an oven door with a towel at right. Bottles with necks, white cups/mugs, and several open bowls sit on the counters. The central white lidded appliance is not cake or a bowl. A small utensil partly obscured among the dishes may be a spoon, but its bowl cannot be resolved, so spoon is unclear. The island is a kitchen counter rather than an identifiable dining table; foods are too nonspecific to identify any listed food category. All 75 definitions were considered.

A full-height two-compartment refrigerator is identifiable at left. The cropped orange upholstered seating at right has a blue throw and colorful cushions, but the crop does not show enough of its width or arms to distinguish a single armchair from a couch, so chair and couch remain unclear. Loose textiles on that seat do not establish a bed or backpack. All 75 definitions were considered; no other unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual sheep have dense fleece and identifiable sheep heads; the black-and-white herding dog is visible on the grass in the upper crop. The sheep are distinct from goats, cattle and plush toys, and the dog is distinct from a cat or bear. The remaining crop is grass. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual people paddle blue kayaks on water. The visible kayak hulls count as boats and are distinct from surfboards or snowboards. Their torso gear is fitted flotation equipment rather than backpacks; the orange and black objects are paddle blades, not kites or rackets. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The crop shows an elevated road, office building, clouds, street lamps and a large Western Ave exit sign. The lamps are not traffic signals and the exit sign is not a stop sign. Very small light and yellow vehicle-like forms on the distant roadway cannot be resolved into passenger cars or trucks, so both plausible vehicle identities remain unclear. No other actual category object is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered.

Actual riders sit on several actual horses whose heads, bodies and legs are visible. The lower edge includes the dashboard/windshield area of the passenger car from which the scene is viewed, supporting an identifiable car part. The roadside sign is a speed sign rather than STOP; the white house awning is not an umbrella. Saddles and horse tack do not establish backpacks or handbags. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A red open-top double-decker bus fills the crop, with actual people on its upper deck and in the foreground. The bus body, windows and mirror establish bus rather than truck or train. Printed championship graphics and figures on the bus do not count as additional actual objects. Clothing and tiny held items do not visibly establish a necktie, drinking cup, bottle or phone. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An empty restaurant contains individual chairs and set dining tables. Numerous drinking vessels have clear bowls, stems and feet, identifying wine glasses; tall necked bottles are visible on the rear shelf. Small pale vessels in the distant place settings do not resolve clearly as cups or deeper bowls rather than plates, so cup and bowl remain unclear. Thin utensils at the settings lack sufficient blade/tine detail, leaving fork and knife unclear. The rear decorative glass vessel may be a vase, but its contents and form are not clear enough to distinguish it from other glass containers, so vase is unclear. All 75 definitions were considered; no people, appliances or potted plants are identifiable.
